## Receive Goods (Rg)

Posts a draft Goods Receipt against its PO: accumulates per-line received quantities on the PO (`receivedQuantities`), snapshots ordered quantities onto the receipt (audit document), flips the PO to received / partially-received, and moves the received value from the budget's `committed` to `actual`. Over-receipt requires a line note and never moves more than the ordered value through the budget. A posted receipt cannot post twice.

### Example

Natural target: the linked posted receipt against PO-2026-0038 (55/55 monitors, fully matched).

### Non-goals

No returns/RMA flow (a negative receipt is not modeled). No invoice matching — that is the v1.1 three-way step.
